PhonePe and Visa Launch New Payment Solutions

Digital payments platform PhonePe, in partnership with Visa, has launched three new payment solutions. These solutions are designed to facilitate contactless payments and support overseas QR transactions. The collaboration aims to enhance the payment experience for users by introducing innovative features. Specific details on the three solutions were not elaborated upon in the coverage.
